entities.summary: Sekope Kepu is an Australian former professional rugby union player. He was a prop and last played for Moana Pasifika in the Super Rugby in 2024. He has previously played for Australian club New South Wales Waratahs, French club Bordeaux, and English side London Irish, as well as the Australia national team. Kepu made his international debut for Australia in 2008 and became a regular squad member, earning over 100 caps in his international career.
